name: Low-Beta Defensive Tilt - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Low-beta systematic-risk tilt (defensive orientation) applied to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), capturing regional low-beta bond opportunities with volatility control scaled to 8% annualised volatility. Emphasizes tail-risk protection and consistent drawdown management within fixed-income markets.
